summary: A lightweight, serverless LAN messaging application built with C++17 and Qt Framework, enabling real-time text communication via a hybrid UDP/TCP networking model for automatic peer discovery and reliable message delivery.
key_features: Zero-config peer discovery via UDP broadcast
Heartbeat-based presence tracking with automatic timeout handling
Real-time dynamic UI with status indicators
achievements: Designed and implemented a hybrid UDP/TCP networking architecture for serverless LAN communication. Developed a custom serialization layer using QDataStream for type-safe packet transmission. Engineered a robust heartbeat mechanism with configurable timeouts (~15s) for automatic peer state management and connection cleanup. Structured the application using a modular, component-based design (UI, Core Logic, Network Abstraction, Serialization) ensuring separation of concerns and maintainability. Integrated CI/CD pipeline via GitHub Actions for automated Windows builds.
